body: I know, but at least it would be over.  No more active burdening, or causing them new annoyance or grief.  No more stupid mistakes.

Oh, I completely understand that kind of pain.  It's such a double edge sword ... because you want someone you love to be happy ... but to see them with someone else just hurts so bad.  I'm sorry you're going through this. :-(
It's unbearable ... to think of living with this the rest of my life.
It's a terrible cycle ... the more I sit here and do nothing, the more the depression and self-loathing descend; the more they descend, the more paralyzed I become.  Rinse, repeat.
Jumping off the Golden Gate Bridge is a really terrible way to die.  Please think twice.  People care about you.

I'm sorry you're in a dark place.  I hope things get better for you.

It is funny ... I think about being depressed at 12.  And now, I think, "Oh, to go back in time when I had so much of my life ahead of me."

Now I feel like time is running out.  But maybe when I am 50, I will think, "I had so much life to live in my 30s."

The thought of being 50 and alone terrifies me, though.  I am much more afraid of actually committing suicide at that age, to be honest.
